1.3 Critical Success Factors

Anchor Identification
Correctly identifying the weekly anchor point is paramount. EUR/USD and OIL use Monday London Range. ETH uses Friday Asian Range.

Wednesday Vigilance
35% of 132% violations occur on Wednesday for EUR/USD and OIL. Reduce position sizes or avoid new entries on Wednesday.

132% Discipline
When 132% level is breached, execute immediate exit. 100% of violations lead to rekey. No exceptions.
Universal Trading Principles
